name: Alli AI
tagline: Alli AI pushes on-page SEO optimizations directly to live websites at scale, without manual developer deployments. Teams use it to run title tag, meta description, and schema changes across thousands of pages from a single dashboard. It connects via a JavaScript snippet and applies changes in real time, bypassing the usual content management bottleneck.
